application_gate_reuse_basis: Latest explicit user proportional-validation authorization; workflow requires meaningful candidate identity and all integrity/publication gates. The only delta removes a blank-line ASCII space; application meaning and all assertions are identical. No claim that fullsuite/build/runtime were rerun after this byte removal.
publication: Not yet published. Completion receipts become durable after secure commit/push succeeds; prior drafts and failure snapshots stay immutable.
publication_acceptance_rule: Secure publisher must rerun required final exact-set/diff gates and verify actual HEAD/origin/main/remote and cleanworktree; containing Gitcommit identifies publication. Historical drafts/stops remain priorstates.
